available.quote: The State Board of Architect Examiners may grant a certificate of registration without examination to any individual who is not registered to engage in the practice of architecture in this state but is certified by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards or has lawfully been issued a license or certificate to engage in the practice of architecture in another jurisdiction of the United States or another country that has qualifications and licensing examinations substantially similar to those required in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud or deception in applying for a certificate of registration or in passing an examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use fraud or deception in applying for a certificate of registration or in passing an examination required under ORS 671.010 to 671.220.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating a registered architect or engaging in the practice of architecture without a certificate of registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely impersonate a registered architect or engage in the practice of architecture in this state without a certificate of registration from the State Board of Architect Examiners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of architecture under an assumed or fictitious business name without registering it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engage in the practice of architecture in this state under an assumed or fictitious business name without registering the assumed or fictitious business name under ORS chapter 648.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, gross negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of architecture or in the provision of architectural services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demonstrate fraud, deceit, gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of architecture or in the provision of architectural services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully evading or attempting to evade any law, ordinance, code, or regulation governing the construction of buildings.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully evade or attempt to evade any law, ordinance, code or regulation of this state, or of counties and cities of this state, that govern the construction of buildings.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Stamping or signing technical submissions the person did not prepare or cause to be prepared under direct control and supervision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Stamp or sign any technical submissions unless the person is a registered architect and prepared the technical submissions or caused the technical submissions to be prepared under the person's direct control and supervision.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving rebates, commissions, grants of money, or favors to which the registered architect is not entitled while doing work for another unaware person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receive rebates, commissions, grants of moneys or favors to which the person is not entitled or is not justified in receiving, if the person is a registered architect and is doing work for another person that is unaware of the rebate, commission, moneys or favor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of architecture or the provision of architectural services contrary to the provisions and requirements of ORS 671.010 to 671.220.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engage in the practice of architecture or the provision of architectural services in a manner contrary to the provisions and requirements of ORS 671.010 to 671.220.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with continuing education requirements adopted by the board, unless waived.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fail to comply with any continuing education requirements the board adopts under ORS 671.125, unless the board waives the requirements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime under circumstances relating to the practice of architecture or the provision of architectural services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Be convicted of any crime under circumstances that relate to the practice of architecture or the provision of architectural services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being the subject of a final disciplinary order suspending or revoking the person's right to practice architecture in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Be the subject of a final order in a disciplinary action that suspends or revokes the person's right to engage in the practice of architecture in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that the board determines is unprofessional or dishonorable.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engage in conduct that the board determines is unprofessional or dishonorable.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a provision of ORS 671.010 to 671.220, a board rule, or a board order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violate a provision of ORS 671.010 to 671.220, a rule the board adopts under ORS 671.010 to 671.220 or an order the board issues under the authority of ORS 671.010 to 671.220.

definition_quote.value: engaging in the art and science of designing, in whole or in part, buildings and the space within and appurtenant to buildings and providing related services that include, but are not limited to, planning, developing design concepts, preparing technical submissions and other documents that define a building's form and function, coordinating construction work and the work of other consultants and providing construction phase services
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of architecture" means engaging in the art and science of designing, in whole or in part, buildings and the space within and appurtenant to buildings and providing related services that include, but are not limited to, planning, developing design concepts, preparing technical submissions and other documents that define a building's form and function, coordinating construction work and the work of other consultants and providing construction phase services.

value: preparing technical submissions and other documents
coordinating construction work and the work of other consultants
methods_authorized.quote: planning, developing design concepts, preparing technical submissions and other documents that define a building's form and function, coordinating construction work and the work of other consultants and providing construction phase services

design_build_authorized.quote: A construction contractor licensed under ORS chapter 701 from offering services constituting the practice of architecture if: (A) The construction contractor's offer discloses in writing that the construction contractor is not an architect and identifies the registered architect or registered architectural firm that will provide the architectural services; (B) The services are ancillary to construction services the construction contractor will provide; and (C) A registered architect or registered architectural firm provides the services constituting the practice of architecture.

permitted_firm_structures.quote: "Business entity" means a partnership, limited partnership, corporation, professional corporation, limited liability company, business trust, joint venture or other form of business organization the constituent parts of which share a common economic interest.

seal_required.quote: Upon receiving a certificate of registration from the board, a registered architect shall obtain a stamp that conforms with a design that the board specifies by rule. The stamp, when accompanied by the registered architect's signature on any technical submission, constitutes the registered architect's attestation that the registered architect has responsible control over the content of the technical submission.

value: board may waive the continuing education requirements
continuing_education_waiver_conditions.quote: unless the board waives the continuing education requirements

value: structure used in connection with or auxiliary to a single family residential dwelling or farm building (including three-car garage, barn, shed, shelter for domestic animals or livestock)
building with ground area of 4,000 square feet or less and not more than 20 feet in height
exempt_building_types.quote: A person that is not an architect from preparing technical submissions or providing construction phase services related to erecting, enlarging or altering a building or an appurtenance to a building if the building or the appurtenance: (A) Is a single family residential dwelling or farm building; (B) Is a structure used in connection with or auxiliary to a single family residential dwelling or farm building, including but not limited to a three-car garage, barn or shed or a shelter used for the housing of domestic animals or livestock; or (C) Has a ground area of 4,000 square feet or less and is not more than 20 feet in height from the top surface of lowest flooring to the highest interior overhead finish.

ncarb_certificate_reciprocity_prima_faci.quote: The State Board of Architect Examiners may grant a certificate of registration without examination to any individual who is not registered to engage in the practice of architecture in this state but is certified by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards

ncarb_standards_adoptable.quote: the board may adopt the examination and the recommended grading procedures of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: A person that violates a provision of ORS 671.010 to 671.220 or a rule the State Board of Architect Examiners adopts under ORS 671.010 to 671.220 is subject to a civil penalty of not more than $5,000 for each violation.
